cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(StudySteadyMotionBridge LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(STUDYSTEADY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../..")
include("${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/cmake/diagnostics.cmake")
find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
execute_process(COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/tools/sdk/prepare_psb_port.py COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
add_library(motion_psb_reader STATIC ${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/build/generated/psb/PSBRawFile.cpp)
set_target_properties(motion_psb_reader PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(motion_psb_reader PUBLIC ${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/native ${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/build/generated/psb)
target_link_libraries(motion_psb_reader PUBLIC z)
if(ENTISGLS_BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS)
add_executable(motion_inspect ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../tests/probes/emote/motion_inspect.cpp)
target_link_libraries(motion_inspect PRIVATE motion_psb_reader)
endif()
add_library(motion_win_atlas STATIC win_atlas.cpp)
set_target_properties(motion_win_atlas PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(motion_win_atlas PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
target_link_libraries(motion_win_atlas PUBLIC motion_psb_reader)
if(ENTISGLS_BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS)
add_executable(motion_texture_probe ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../tests/probes/emote/motion_texture_probe.cpp)
target_link_libraries(motion_texture_probe PRIVATE motion_win_atlas)
endif()
if(ANDROID)
    add_library(motion_gles_atlas STATIC gles_atlas.cpp)
    set_target_properties(motion_gles_atlas PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
    target_link_libraries(motion_gles_atlas PUBLIC motion_win_atlas GLESv2)
if(ENTISGLS_BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS)
    add_executable(motion_gles_probe ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../tests/probes/emote/motion_gles_probe.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(motion_gles_probe PRIVATE motion_gles_atlas EGL)
endif()
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/tools/sdk/motion_prepare_math.py COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
if(ENTISGLS_BUILD_DIAGNOSTICS)
add_executable(motion_pose_probe ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../../tests/probes/emote/pose_probe.cpp)
target_include_directories(motion_pose_probe PRIVATE ${STUDYSTEADY_ROOT}/build/generated/motion)
target_link_libraries(motion_pose_probe PRIVATE motion_win_atlas)
endif()
